scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.test:incident-review-evidence-contract: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts exec tsx validation/incident-review-evidence-contract.test.ts
scripts.test:web-port-contracts: analyst_status=0; canvas_status=0; echo 'Analyst Workbench port contract:'; pnpm --filter @workspace/analyst-workbench run test:port || analyst_status=$?; echo 'Canvas port contract:'; pnpm --filter @workspace/mockup-sandbox run validate:port || canvas_status=$?; if [ "$analyst_status" -ne 0 ] || [ "$canvas_status" -ne 0 ]; then echo "Web port contract validation failed (Analyst Workbench: $analyst_status; Canvas: $canvas_status)." >&2; exit 1; fi
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.validate: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server test && pnpm --filter @workspace/analyst-workbench test && pnpm --filter @workspace/mockup-sandbox run validate:preview-path && pnpm --filter @workspace/mockup-sandbox run validate:port && pnpm run test:stale-api-declarations && pnpm run build
